title: Region
description: A kind: Region file, the content the platform change P-07 adds under regions/. One region, global, ships now; it is an ordinary region, and nothing in code compares a region name to the string global. The hub keeps its copy in type-overlays/regions/ until the platform carries it.

name.description: The region id: the region segment of every wfrn in it, so it never changes (check region.name.invalid)

partition.description: The wfrn partition the region belongs to; fixed per installation

status.description: available: open to every account; opt-in: accounts enable it; retired: no new resources, existing names stay valid

environments.description: The environments a provider may serve in this region (check provider.region.environment.unknown); the first one is the default an observe call uses when the type has no environment field
